### Fieldsets
Grouped form sections, from the HTML.

#### Selection and adaptation

Runtime ownership: `css-only`. [Related Google guidance](https://m3.material.io/components/text-fields/overview)

Example: A promotional feature block needs a section or card. Use a fieldset when a shared legend explains related inputs, such as delivery preferences.

#### Material mapping

Relationship: related. Related guidance is not a dedicated component specification.

Support: Outlined, filled, and rounded form groups.

Web adaptation: Native fieldset/legend; related text-field tokens do not make this an M3 component.

Full parity remains unassessed. Review provenance and specification links: [capability evidence](../references/capability-roadmap.md#fieldsets).

#### Contract

A `<fieldset>` is the group. A `<legend>` is the headline. Everything else is a field — `.field`, radios, switches, a `.inline` row of radios, a trailing `<small>` as supporting text. There is no wrapper class. They are CSS only. There is no JavaScript component and nothing to AutoInit.

Material Design 3 has no fieldset component. Tokens follow the outlined grouping container used around related form content, and the [outlined text-field](https://m3.material.io/components/text-fields/specs) shape so a group of fields matches the fields. The container is 4dp corners and a 1dp `outline-variant` stroke. The legend is `title-small` / `on-surface`. Supporting text is `body-small`. Padding is 16dp; children sit 16dp apart. Disabled is 38%.

#### Syntax

```html
<fieldset>
  <legend>Name</legend>
  <div class="field">
    <input id="first" type="text" placeholder=" ">
    <label for="first">First name</label>
  </div>
  <div class="field">
    <input id="last" type="text" placeholder=" ">
    <label for="last">Last name</label>
  </div>
</fieldset>
```

#### App behavior

For how a form with these groups submits, shows its errors and moves focus, follow the App behavior in the text field guide (Text Inputs).

#### Also documented

The Fieldsets section of the [API reference](https://www.expressivecss.com/llm.md) also covers Choices, Variants, Disabled.

#### Rules

- `fieldset-has-legend`: A fieldset without a legend groups controls visually but names nothing.
